actor.description: Who acted: the requester, or the Owner in the bootstrap.

approval_id.description: The approved request, for an approved change.

due_at.description: A break-glass's review's due date: 7 days after it ended (FM-8). Absent for other entries.

kind.description: approved_change: a change a second person approved (FM-1); founder_bootstrap: a role change or invitation the Owner made alone before a second member joined (FR-ADM-01); self_approved: a journal a founder posted alone at or below the self-approval threshold (FM-2); scheduled_issue: an invoice the scheduler issued and sent from an approved recurring invoice (FR-AR-07); auto_reconciled: a bank line the system reconciled, in the week's sample (FR-BNK-14); release_conflict: in Founder mode, a payment batch released by who prepared or approved it or a payee's account change (SOD-1, SOD-2); break_glass: an Owner's break-glass, reviewed with what it released through reviewBreakGlass once it has ended (FM-8); account_recovery: a member recovered their account with a recovery code and a confirmation (SEC-35).

overdue.description: true when it is still unreviewed 14 days after it executed, in Founder mode: Checks shows it as a warning (FM-3). A break-glass is overdue from its due date, in any mode, and Checks shows it as cannot post until fixed (C.2 #53).

summary.description: What it did, in a sentence.
examples: Change Tolerance for base-currency differences from 1.00 to 5.00 from 2026-10-20

you_may_review.description: true when you may review it now: it is unreviewed, you did not act on it and you hold the approval right on what it changed. Always false for a break-glass, reviewed through reviewBreakGlass.
